svg.text: TryAWS.now Pro — AWS Marketplace AMI with CloudFormation (standard deployment)
One CloudFormation stack in the buyer's own AWS account (dedicated account recommended). All resources below are created by the template unless marked as existing.
Security group: 443/80 from anywhere, 22 from OperatorCidr
Global services in the same account
AssumeRole on the Tc roles, CheckoutLicense,
for customer DNS zones and domains
No long-term access keys are created or requested.
All AWS access uses the EC2 instance role (IMDSv2).
Manage customer Lightsail (through the Tc roles)
